title: Floods, Fires and Global Updates

slides.headline: Floods, Fires and Global Updates
slides.subtitle: Five key stories from around the world to keep you informed today.

slides.headline: Massive earthquake hits Indonesia
slides.explanation: A 7.7-magnitude quake struck the Flores region, triggering a tsunami warning and sending thousands to higher ground. It serves as a stark reminder of the region's vulnerability to seismic activity.

slides.headline: Arson arrests spike across France
slides.explanation: Authorities have arrested nearly 500 people for allegedly starting wildfires as Europe grapples with a brutal summer fire season. This crackdown highlights the intense pressure on emergency services across the continent.

slides.headline: Deadly rains paralyze eastern Japan
slides.explanation: Unprecedented rainfall has caused landslides and flooding, leaving thousands stranded at Narita airport. These extreme weather events are forcing hundreds of thousands to flee their homes for safety.

slides.headline: Guilty plea in CEO killing
slides.explanation: Luigi Mangione has admitted to killing the CEO of a healthcare company in Manhattan. The case has drawn significant attention due to the high-profile nature of the victim and the public admission of guilt.

slides.headline: Kellogg phasing out artificial dyes
slides.explanation: The cereal giant is removing artificial colors from all its products by the end of this year. This shift reflects a growing corporate trend to address consumer demand for simpler ingredients.

title: AI Boom, Market Highs, and More

slides.headline: AI Boom, Market Highs, and More
slides.subtitle: Get caught up on today's top business and finance news in just a few swipes.

slides.headline: Goldman Sachs cashes in on AI
slides.explanation: The bank is helping tech giants like Nvidia and Intel fund their massive infrastructure needs. It shows how much money is flowing into the physical hardware required to power AI.

slides.headline: Luigi Mangione pleads guilty
slides.explanation: The man accused of killing a UnitedHealthcare CEO has entered a guilty plea to federal stalking charges. This comes just before a major state murder trial starts in New York.

slides.headline: Watch these stocks move premarket
slides.explanation: Reddit, Applied Materials, and Wayfair are seeing significant trading activity before the opening bell. Tracking these shifts helps you see where investor sentiment is moving today.

slides.headline: Why the stock market keeps climbing
slides.explanation: New data shows that record-high profit margins are driving the current rally, not just sales growth. Companies are finding ways to be more efficient rather than just selling more goods.

slides.headline: Disposable BBQ ban issued
slides.explanation: The government is temporarily banning single-use grills due to extreme wildfire risks during current heatwaves. Officials say these products are a significant danger to public safety right now.
